name: Timelapse
scaffolding_intent: Plays a day-night cycle over the scene, signaling that time passes or that something happens later

parameters.name: isIndoor
parameters.description: Indoor scenes use warm lighting shift instead of sky gradient

parameters.name: nightOpacity
parameters.description: Opacity of the night overlay darkening

correction_intent: Child described as instant, finished, or current something the scene shows as ongoing, long, or still to come ('the sunflower grew this morning' for slow growth; 'they ate dinner' for a table being set). Not for grammatical tense errors; that is D4.
suggestion_intent: The scene shows time passing or something coming later (growth, waiting, preparations, the day ending) and the child has not mentioned the time of day, the passage of time, or what happens next. Requires a visible temporal cue.
